future_grid_limits.checkpoint_note: A budget failure writes partial diagnostic with no evidence claim; never overwrite outputs or extend automatically.

grid.center_source: verified P45 independent fit receipt, no refits. Original evidence function refits from default start for each n; full original evidence centers/sigmas not in reduced archived JSON, so exact grid geometry is reconstructed, not byte-identical claimed.
grid.axes: Each non-beta parameter: inclusive linspace(max(priorlo,center-6sigma),min(priorhi,center+6sigma),n); beta free: entire inclusive prior[-.05,.05]. Fallback sigma .05priorwidth only if missing/zero, identical to historical function; current receipt sigmas present.
grid.sum: logsumexp(finite(-chi2/2)) + sum(log(delta_axis)) - sum(log(prior_width)); constant endpoint weights, not trapezoid. Invalid points retain zero likelihood and are counted.
grid.support: Declared priors strict open boundaries: endpoints rejected as historical motor. CAMB index1<=pos<=n_axis-2; no extrapolation. Use broad prior volume, do not renormalize to table box or fit box.
grid.fixed_beta: 0 for LCDM; ALPHA_FINE_CODATA_2018*sqrt(e) runtime for TGL; c=0
grid.reuses: P5 LCDM identical between readings; reproduce once for each n. T4,P45,SN-only fits not repeated.
grid.marginal: beta n25 density normalized by sum*dBeta; linear interpolation for Savage-Dickey; node-CDF quantiles and sums at beta thresholds reproduce historical discretization, not continuous posterior estimator.
grid.laplace: Historical diagnostic only: logLhat+d/2log(2pi)+sum(log(sigma_j))-logVprior. Uses product marginal variances, not determinant of full covariance. No replacement of grid.
grid.covariance: P45 full Planck/DR2/SN blocks; absent cross-block covariance declared. No CC; no scalar SH0ES in P5.

evidence_status.absolute: Historical lnZ omits Gaussian data normalization and profiles M without finite normalized prior; do not label a normalized absolute data evidence.
evidence_status.relative: Within same data/likelihood and parameter-independent covariance, omitted data constants cancel. For common M nuisance, integrating common flat measure multiplies exp(-chi2prof/2) by sqrt(2pi/(1^TC^-1 1)), constant across models/readings. Relative comparisons coincide under common compatible broad-prior limit, not arbitrary different M priors.
evidence_status.truncation: Fit-centered +/-6sigma background box omits prior-domain tails; 25/35 comparison does not bound omitted tails. Preserve numerical target; no claim of certified full prior evidence.
evidence_status.table: Likelihood zero outside computational CAMB support is historical INPUT, not an astrophysical exclusion.
evidence_status.comparisons: Only within each family or P5 same-data shadow/accumulated; no multiplying F4 and F5 or claiming absolute lnZ comparable between datasets.

tolerances.likelihood_numerics: Reuse P45 GL64/128 passed; no new fit or table test here.

convergence_policy: After separate authorization compute n25/n35 for same axes; retain both and abs difference. Above0.01 declares grid unresolved, never silently promotes n35 or expands grid. Compare archived max error within0.001 engineering tolerance; this is not rigorous integration error. Savage-Dickey discrepancy from direct Bayes ratio reported as its own coarse-grid diagnostic, not forced to zero.

synthetic.purpose: Analytic Gaussian integral and point-density/CDF errors; endpoint constant-function check; no observational data integral.
